profile.headline: Entrepreneur // Software Developer
profile.summary:
Proven business professional and software developer with a passion for entrepreneurship and startups. I specialize in taking new product concepts and turning them into market-ready software applications quickly and efficiently.

Having worked on several startups and been on both sides of the table (as a founder and a contract developer), I intimately understand the process and challenge of building a company from the ground up. As such, I bring a unique perspective to the table that's versed in business, finance, product, and technology. 

As a consultant, I always strive to provide a transparent, organized, and collaborative work environment where we share the same north star and strategy to get there. I find that's the best way to produce exceptional work and build relationships for the long-term.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Mile Hi Labs is a software design and development agency that specializes in web, mobile, and cloud-computing applications. Our expertise includes 5+ years of full-stack software development for startups and SMBs with a focus on:

• Marketplace applications
• Data aggregation services
• API services
• On-demand platforms
• Internet of things
• Software as a service
• Platform as a service
• Data integration
• Other ideas

At Mile Hi Labs, we honed our skills as startup founders where we learned how to design, build and scale platforms that just work. With that comes the ability and knowledge to avoid common pitfalls while staying laser-focused on your north star.

positions.title: Founder // Developer
positions.description:
Myhub was an event platform for small to medium-sized businesses that combined comprehensive event registration tools with customizable widgets that worked on any website. I founded the business in June 2013 on a simple premise that every SMB would desire an event platform that combined event registration and marketing tools to engage, interact and network with their community.

After a long journey, we decided to permanently shut down the business in early 2020 having facilitated over 20k tickets sold and $1M in gross market value. While we didn't achieve the outcome we were looking for, Myhub was an excellent learning experience that also led to my passion for software, technology, and startups.

positions.title: Founder // Developer
positions.description: Joyrides is a reverse-auction booking system for coach bus and luxury limousine operators. At Joyrides, I was responsible for strategic planning, brand development, UI / UX design, and front-end development.

positions.title: Marketing Director
positions.description:
KBS Golf Shafts is a premiere steel golf shaft manufacturer with strong business relationships at every OEM. Their product is also trusted by several of the world’s top professional golfers. At KBS, I was responsible for all brand development and marketing-related activities.

Responsibilities:
- Global Marketing Strategy
- Product & Corporate Branding
- Product-to-market planning
- R&D Support
- Project Management
- Press Relations
- Media Buys
- Social Media
- Promotions
- Account Management

Sample Accomplishments:
- Managed $500K marketing budget for advertising, sponsorships, and branding activities.
- Developed the KBS Shaft Fit system performing shaft fittings for over 200,000 people.
- Developed an Email Marketing program from inception to over 50,000 opt-in email addresses.
- Developed the KBS Certified Fitter program certifying 1,000+ PGA Professionals.

positions.title: Commercial Projects Intern
positions.description: Collaborated with regional Energy Service Companies to collect data on energy efficiency projects implemented with state and government buildings (K-12 schools, universities, city and state buildings, airports, etc.)

positions.title: Media Group Intern
positions.description: Assisted with general research, competitor analysis, exploring ad trends, senior-level presentations, and ran a promotional campaign for The Vermont Student Assistance Corporation. Special focus on the emerging mobile marketing landscape.

educations.schoolName: American School of The Hague, NL

volunteerExperiences.description: At DA2030, I'm responsible for our website, system integrations, email marketing, e-commerce, and registration / ticketing at our events. Since joining Da2030, I've led a concerted effort to modernize our technologies through a consolidation and simplification of the platforms we use.
With SVP, I helped oversee the CRM transition for a Denver-area Non-Profit which we identified as the major bottleneck in their efforts to modernize their organization and integrate their systems.
